[[File:SepSupplyShip2-POD.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] over [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]]]
A '''supply ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carrying a variety of supplies. One was used around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] as a cargo ship for the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] prison of [[Desolation Alley]], and another was the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] ship [[Verity (Galactic Alliance)|''Verity'']].
